data.name: Bob
data.message: Hey Charlie, I'm doing asteroids here. Want to buddy up after?

data.name: Bob
data.message: Just one more part of this task left, Charlie!

I found Bob's body in weapons. My route was navigation to security, and then to weapons. The crucial part is that when I was in security just a moment before, I saw Charlie walking directly out of weapons. I went into weapons immediately after him and found Bob dead. Charlie is 100% the Duck here. Vote Charlie!

I was on the other side of the map for this entire round. I started down in storage, moved up to medbay, and was just in electrical when the meeting was called. I actually didn't cross paths with a single person, so I can't confirm or deny what happened over by weapons. 

That being said, Eve, that is a very hard accusation. Charlie, you're going to have to explain yourself right now. Why were you leaving weapons, and where were you before that? If Charlie doesn't have an airtight defense or a buddy to vouch for him, I think we have to follow Eve's lead on this one. Let's hear what everyone else has to say.

I started in lower engine and just moved into storage before the meeting was called. I didn't cross paths with anyone either. Diana, your route makes sense—if you started in storage and moved up to medbay, you would have left before I got there, which is why we didn't see each other. 

Regarding Eve's accusation: that is as direct as it gets. With only one Duck in this game, this is a textbook 1-for-1 situation. If Eve is telling the truth, we vote Charlie and win. If Eve is lying and Charlie is innocent, we just vote Eve at the next meeting and we still win. 

Charlie, we need to hear your defense right now. Unless Frank can somehow completely clear you, I'm fully on board with voting Charlie today.

I've been on the far left side of the map this entire round. I started in upper engine, went up to oxygen to do a task, and then came right back down to upper engine. I haven't seen a single soul the entire time, so I can't vouch for anyone or give any info on the right side of the map.

Alice, your logic is totally spot on. With 5 of us left and only 1 Duck, a 1-for-1 trade is a guaranteed win for the Geese. Eve is making a hard, direct accusation. Since I can't clear Charlie, we have to play the numbers. 

Charlie, you're up next. Unless you have some kind of absolute proof that Eve is self-reporting and lying, I'm voting for you. If the game doesn't end after we vote Charlie, we all know to immediately hit the emergency button and vote out Eve.

Alice and Frank, your 1-for-1 logic is totally correct, but you have the order backwards—Eve is projecting hard right now to save her own feathers. 

Here is exactly what just happened. I started in Cafeteria and went straight down to Security to do my task and check the cameras. While I was on cams, I literally watched Eve walk from Navigation, pass by me in Security, and head up into Weapons where Bob was. A second later, I saw the kill happen on the camera feed. 

I immediately jumped off the cameras and was turning around to run up to Cafeteria to slam the emergency button. Eve must have noticed the camera light was blinking and realized I was right next door in Security watching her. She panicked and self-reported the body to beat me to the punch, instantly framing the only person who caught her red-handed. 

Think about it: why would she make such a desperate hard accusation? Because she knew she was caught. Let's do the 1-for-1, but you have to vote the self-reporter first. Vote Eve today. If the game somehow doesn't end, you can vote me next round, but I guarantee you this is game over. Vote Eve!

Nice try, Charlie, but your story is completely falling apart. 

First of all, there are no security cameras inside Weapons, so you couldn't possibly have "watched the kill happen on the camera feed." Second, I literally watched you walk into Security *from* Weapons, not from Cafeteria. You were fleeing the crime scene right before I walked in and found Bob. 

Alice and Frank, your logic is exactly right. This is a guaranteed 1-for-1 win for us Geese. Charlie is backed into a corner and just throwing out a desperate lie to try and save himself. Vote Charlie today. If the game doesn't end, you have my full permission to hit the button and vote me out next. Let's finish this.

Eve just nailed it. Charlie, your defense completely falls apart when you claim you saw the kill *inside* Weapons on the camera feed. Cameras only show the hallways, they don't see inside that room. That is a massive slip-up and it makes it obvious you're just throwing out a desperate lie to cover your tracks. 

Alice and Frank have it exactly right with the 1-for-1 strategy. Since Charlie's story has a glaring hole in it, he is definitely the one we need to vote first. I'm voting Charlie today. If the game somehow doesn't end, we all know to immediately hit the button and vote out Eve next, but I'm fully confident Charlie is our Duck here. Let's finish this.

Eve and Diana are exactly right. Charlie, you really shot yourself in the foot with that defense. Anyone who has played this game knows the security cameras only cover the hallways, not the inside of the rooms themselves. Claiming you literally watched the kill happen inside Weapons on the camera feed is a massive, undeniable lie. 

You panicked because Eve caught you red-handed, and you made up a story on the spot without thinking through the mechanics of the map. The 1-for-1 logic still stands, but now we don't even have to flip a coin on who to vote first. Your story is factually impossible, Charlie. 

I'm locking in my vote for Charlie right now. Frank, follow suit and let's end this game.

Charlie, they're absolutely right. You really gave yourself away with that camera claim. There is no camera inside Weapons, so your story is physically impossible. You got caught leaving the body by Eve, panicked, and tried to invent a defense that just doesn't work with the map layout. 

The 1-for-1 strategy was already our guaranteed path to victory, but you just made it incredibly easy to choose who goes first. I'm locking in my vote for Charlie. Geese, let's wrap this up!

Okay, I admit I misspoke in the heat of the moment, but you guys are missing the point. I didn't mean I saw the literal kill animation *inside* Weapons. I was on the hallway cams, I saw Bob walk up that right-side hallway, and I saw Eve following right behind him. Two seconds later, she reports the body. I connected the dots and said "I saw it happen" because I was panicking that she was hard-accusing me out of nowhere. 

I know I'm dead here. My fate is completely sealed because of how I worded it, and the 1-for-1 logic dictates you have to vote me. I get it. But I promise you, when I get ejected and the Goose victory screen doesn't pop up, you have to sprint to Cafeteria and hit that emergency button for Eve. Vote me today, but do not let her win this after I'm gone. Vote Eve tomorrow.
